title: QosPanel re-derives node names from index instead of reading the staged sites' names
evidence: scripts/qos_panel.gd:121-122: `var an: String = _node_name(p.a)` / `var bn: String = _node_name(p.b)`; scripts/qos_panel.gd:138: `return "n%02d" % (idx + 1)`; scripts/world_seed.gd:129-132: `idx += 1` / `out.append({` / `"name": "n%02d" % idx,`
detail: The panel duplicates WorldSeed's naming format to rebuild names the world already owns. If placement naming changes, panel titles silently drift from the actual NodeSite.site_name values.
recommended_fix: Resolve titles from the staged sites (thread nodes_container/main into QosPanel.open, read site.site_name) or expose a WorldSeed.name_for(idx) helper both use.

title: capture_runner re-declares the 16-pipe replay-evidence network that test_sim_base canonizes as a single shared definition
evidence: scripts/capture_runner.gd:87-93: `for pair in [` / `[1, 0], [2, 0], [3, 0], [4, 0],` / `[0, 9], [10, 9], [12, 9], [13, 9],` / `[9, 11], [13, 11], [15, 11], [17, 11],` / `[11, 22], [23, 22], [25, 22], [27, 22],` / `]:`; scripts/capture_runner.gd:99: `main._on_qos_apply(int(spine_bundle.id), [50, 30, 20], {"email": 2, "streaming": 0})` — versus tests/test_sim_base.gd:15-17: `## The replay-evidence command stream — ONE definition shared by` / `## tests/test_sim_replay.gd and tools/determinism_log.gd so the committed` / `## capture and its sibling test can never drift apart.` followed by the identical 16 add_pipe pairs + `{"cmd": "set_lanes", "pipe": 5, "alloc": [50, 30, 20], "cls_lane": {"email": 2, "streaming": 0}}`
detail: The exact topology the replay contract pins is hand-maintained in two places; editing one silently desyncs the visual captures from the determinism evidence.
recommended_fix: Hoist the pair list (or full REPLAY_CMDS) into one shared const — e.g. in SimBalance or a harness script — that both capture_runner and test_sim_base consume.

title: Capture harness reaches into main's private QoS handlers instead of a programmatic door, breaking the project's own capture convention
evidence: scripts/capture_runner.gd:104: `main._on_qos_apply(int(spine_bundle.id), [50, 30, 20], {"email": 2, "streaming": 0})`; scripts/capture_runner.gd:112-113: `main._on_pipe_selected(pipe_id)` / `main._on_qos_apply(pipe_id, [50, 30, 20], {"email": 2, "streaming": 0})` — contrast scripts/connect_controller.gd:96-98: `## Programmatic commit — used by the release path AND the capture harness` / `func connect_programmatic(a: NodeSite, b: NodeSite) -> PipeArc:` / `return _main.request_connect(a, b)`
detail: Every other captured verb goes through a designated public programmatic door; QoS panel-open/apply pokes underscore-prefixed handlers directly, so refactoring main's wiring silently breaks captures.
recommended_fix: Add a public programmatic door on main (e.g. select_pipe(pipe_id) / apply_qos(...)) or drive the real QosPanel buttons, and have captures use it.

title: bundle_for_pair is the only untyped-return function in the new sim/view surface, cascading untyped locals to callers
evidence: scripts/sim/sim_core.gd:186: `func bundle_for_pair(a: int, b: int):` — the only `func` without `->` among 28 in the file (all others e.g. `func pipe_count(a: int, b: int) -> int:`); consequence at scripts/main.gd:80: `var bundle = sim.bundle_for_pair(a.node_index, b.node_index)` (untyped local) and scripts/capture_runner.gd:98: `var spine_bundle = spine_sim.bundle_for_pair(...)`
detail: Inconsistent with the project's otherwise fully-typed signatures; the null-or-Dictionary return is implicit, weakening type errors at call sites.
recommended_fix: Annotate `-> Variant` (Dictionary or null) and type the call-site locals (`var bundle: Variant = ...`).
